categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: precision metal stamping components mainly for hard disk drives and electronic parts; medical plastic consumables including injection molded medical products and related automation equipment; and custom automation machinery for various industries including 3C electronics, medical, and traditional manufacturing sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include precision metal stamping with advanced surface treatment and plating, computer-aided engineering (CAE) simulation, and integration of robotics and automation in production. Medical plastics leverage multi-stage injection molding, cleanroom manufacturing, and automated optical inspection. Automation machinery development focuses on modular design, integration of mechanical, control, optical, and software modules, and customized solutions for assembly and testing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are global hard disk drive manufacturers (Western Digital, Seagate, Toshiba), semiconductor and electronic device makers, medical technology companies, and manufacturers requiring automation solutions. Major end markets include data storage, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, medical devices, and industrial automation sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing and sales facilities in Taiwan, Singapore, China (Suzhou), Malaysia, and Thailand, serving customers globally with major sales in Asia, Europe, and the Americas. It maintains overseas warehouses and production sites to support global supply chains and customer proximity.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment as a manufacturer and supplier of precision components and automation equipment, providing value-added services such as design, development, and assembly to downstream OEMs and brand owners in electronics, medical, and industrial sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing precision metal stamping technologies for high-capacity storage devices, expanding medical plastic consumables with enhanced cleanroom and automated inspection capabilities, and growing automation machinery business globally. R&D focuses on AI-driven optical inspection, advanced forming techniques, multi-material molding, and modular automation solutions. The company also emphasizes sustainability, digital transformation, and talent development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of precision metal components, medical plastic parts, and custom automation machinery. The company also provides related technical services, including design, prototyping, and after-sales support, with no indication of subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors in metal stamping include Southeast Asian and Taiwanese firms such as Interplex, Amtek, IPT, and NHK Spring. In medical plastics, competition comes from multinational and regional specialized manufacturers. The company holds a strong market position with a 30% global share in hard disk drive voice coil motor plates and is recognized for quality, automation, and integrated manufacturing capabilities, maintaining long-term partnerships with leading global customers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$2.4 billion in 2024, a 15% increase from the prior year, with net profit doubling to NT$182.8 million. It maintains steady growth with improving profitability metrics, including a return on equity of 9.44% and earnings per share of NT$2.37. The firm invests around 2-3% of revenue in R&D and plans capacity expansions to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes integrated precision manufacturing with high-quality standards, advanced automation, and strong R&D capabilities to deliver customized, high-performance components and equipment. Its vertical integration, cleanroom facilities, and compliance with international certifications (ISO, RBA, SA8000) provide customers with reliable, cost-effective solutions. The firm’s global footprint and strategic partnerships enable responsive service and innovation tailored to evolving market demands.
